exact.rule: Exact legacy recovery requires deterministic identity, event, route, and timestamp evidence.

linked.rule: Linked recovery requires a deterministic linkId or identity transfer.

inferred.rule: Exact source with incomplete identity is inferred at maximum.

weak.rule: Partial route or event match remains weak.

unknown.rule: Unknown source or identity is archive-only and cannot become exact.

candidates.reason: Guest batch page views can explain historical navigation but lack exact linked identity.
candidates.accuracyImpact: Improves historical surface trend explanations while keeping user truth weak.
candidates.userVisibleImpact: No user-facing numbers change until an approved recovery import exists.

candidates.reason: Unlock records with drop id and user/session can recover access intent, but entitlement/payment truth remains separate.
candidates.accuracyImpact: Separates unlock from unwrap and watch for better creator/drop metrics.
candidates.userVisibleImpact: No entitlement or payment record is mutated.

candidates.reason: Old free labels become reward_gd unless deterministic paid purchase package proof exists.
candidates.accuracyImpact: Prevents legacy source labels from funding paid-only experiences.
candidates.userVisibleImpact: No wallet balance or spend policy changes in dry-run mode.

candidates.reason: Unknown legacy source or identity cannot become exact current truth.
candidates.accuracyImpact: Blocks unsupported promotions and keeps unknowns visible for operator review.
candidates.userVisibleImpact: No user-facing metric consumes unknown legacy as exact.
